statement: A verifier rejection must stay recordable after the repair it demands, and a doneWhen bar that only grows must not need a rejection finding at all: bind rejection findings to the sealed review manifest rather than to current worktree bytes, add a monotone receipt-bar-strengthen amendment, and validate scope before bytes so the refusal message names the actionable flag.

constraints.statement: This is a process Quest: it changes scripts/solve*, its tests and docs only. No src/ file changes, and no runtime behaviour of the database itself is touched.

A verifier-rejection finding validates its fingerprint against the sealed review manifest (solve/state/reviews/<id>.json manifest.candidate/aggregate fingerprint), which is immutable once minted, rather than against current worktree bytes. This makes a rejection recordable after the repair it demanded, because the referent is what WAS verified, not what is present now.

receipt-bar-strengthen accepts only a strict superset of the sealed requiredReceipts on the same probe and the same receipt file. It can never remove, rename or rewrite a receipt, never change doneWhen.probe, and therefore needs no verifier-rejection finding: it can only make the bar harder.

A strengthened bar updates the frontier metric args as well as doneWhen args wherever they share the probe and receipt file, because the test-receipt probe measures only requiredReceipts; strengthening doneWhen alone would raise a bar that nothing measures.

Scope validity is checked before any current-bytes comparison, so the refusal a caller sees names the actionable flag and does not depend on whether the quest happens to have candidate-contract attempts.

Existing recorded amendments and rejection findings keep their meaning; the existing amendment kinds, the amendment limit, and the evidence-linkage rule for verifier-driven kinds are unchanged, proven by controls that must stay green.
Proof is a deterministic node:test witness on temp roots, red on HEAD and green after, with existing-amendment-kinds-unchanged and existing-rejection-flow-unchanged as controls that must stay green.
